stage: Bank independent held-out evaluation; frozen-step budget frontiers
step_convention: Canonical h: -h P gradient + sqrt(2h) L Z, L L.T = P
selection_record: BANK_HELDOUT_SELECTION_v1.json records pilot-only evidence. Within each CV1/ULA original full-H grid, require zero failed replicas through K2048; minimize worst ratio across both references and both accuracy metrics to the componentwise best own-method pilot means; tie by warm cost then cold cost then smaller h. This operational tie/ranking rule is recorded at final freeze before any held-out observation. CV2 is fixed by the validated bounded extension, with no further search.
initialization: Every replica starts at unchanged Bank mode; independent replica/iteration/purpose RNG streams; shared streams across methods/seeds where applicable; exact without-replacement subsets
metric: Unchanged symmetric sqrt(anchor posterior Hessian), 128 frozen projections and stored scoring reference draws. Replica endpoint empirical SW2 and ergodic-average posterior variance NRMSE. Alternate reference evaluated separately. These measure distinct accuracy objects.
reference: Reuse passed longer Bank reference pools unchanged; no new reference sampling, reprocessing or target modification
failure: Original permanent rule: nonfinite proposal or standardized radius>100 sqrt(d). Any failed replica invalidates its ensemble from first failure onward. Any failed seed invalidates configuration/checkpoint mean accuracy and frontier eligibility. Retain all costs and failures; no survivor-only averaging. Continue padded work through fixed budget unless cap is reached.

accuracy_targets.scope: Prespecified descriptive joint empirical-accuracy target informed by pilot, required on both reference means; not a population W2 certification. Report first attainable frozen budget for cold and warm separately. Never report finite speedup if either method has no observed attainment.

cost: Seconds for complete 512-replica batch. Warm=recorded anchor optimization attribution + measured transfer/cache/metric/state setup + synchronized cumulative sampling. Cold=warm+attributed first-use sampler compilation. Functional/scoring/reference/backup work separate. First-run setup retained. Warm is compiled-code reuse with fresh state, not posterior warm initialization.
inference: Primary K2048: paired seed bootstrap CV2-CV1 differences in mean empirical SW2 and variance NRMSE, plus cold/warm mean time ratios, independently on each reference. Percentile 95% intervals from 19999 shared resampled seed sets. Intervals condition on fixed reference pools and measured compilation/setup; no inner-replica bootstrap or absolute population SW2 guarantee. ULA and other budgets descriptive/exploratory. No CIs for invalid accuracy points. Report all failures. Frontier is the evaluated frozen-step budget frontier, not a globally optimized method frontier.
resume: Separate immutable source/freeze lock. No overwrite or automatic rerun of a used seed. Interrupted/failed jobs remain explicit; recovery requires audit.
stop_rule: No parameter tuning or budget extension after seeing held-out. Finish fixed runs within caps, save and report results, including null or negative efficiency outcomes.
